title: Airflow and surface are different
hook: Which change alters flux while keeping exposed area fixed?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: The model keeps cloth area fixed and changes the assumed mass-transfer flux. Area and transfer conditions multiply; changing one does not secretly change the other.

claims.text: Does improving airflow expose an inner towel face that is still folded shut?
claims.source: Transfer prompt, grounded by this lesson's mechanism and limitations.

claims.text: Rate = exposed area × flux. The fan changes flux, not area, so the rate doubles while the area stays 1.5 m². A face folded shut stays hidden however the air moves. The doubling is illustrative, not a fan measurement.
